record_title: Gaussian local limits and exact constants for weighted-representation partitions
provenance: Sharp local-limit refinement of the weighted-representation partition counts studied by Li, Xu and Yan in arXiv:2609.20385v1, using their finite boundary sign system together with an explicit Gram-matrix calculation and Fourier lattice local-limit analysis.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The foundational 2012 Yang--Chen J. Number Theory paper was not inspected in full; the 2026 primary source summarizes its f_k result as finiteness and logarithmic growth. The theorem keeps k fixed and does not address growing-k uniformity or deviations larger than the square-root scale. Numerical verification supports but does not replace the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
